feature.title: Extend a finished course from its page
feature.problem: Courses can now grow (POST /api/courses/:id/extend: plan new modules on top of what the course teaches, review, then write only them), but only through the API. The owner should be able to say 'also teach X' on a finished course, review the new modules the same way as a new outline, and keep reading the course while the new part is written.
nonGoals: Editing or rewriting existing lessons: an extension only appends modules.
Extending courses imported from a folder (no builder plan): the menu item is hidden for them.
The phone and iPad reader: it shows the new modules once written, with no extend action.

surfaces.name: Course page: Extend this course

moments.peak: typing 'also teach options and execution' and seeing it start planning new modules on top of the course
moments.end: back on the course page, a quiet banner says the new modules are being planned, waiting for review, or being written, with a link

surfaces.purpose: Ask for more of a finished course, and see where that request stands.

panels.title: Extension banner (only while one is in progress)

fields.label: Planning
fields.value: Planning new modules on top of this course…  [See progress]

fields.label: Review
fields.value: 8 new modules are ready for you to review.  [Review them]

fields.label: Writing
fields.value: Writing 77 new lessons. You can keep reading.  [See progress]

states.empty: No extension in progress: no banner.
states.error: The extension's planning failed: the banner says 'Planning the new modules failed' with Try again (sends the same request) and Dismiss.
states.success: When the new modules are written the banner goes and they appear at the end of the outline.

surfaces.purpose: Follow the extension and approve its outline, exactly as a new course's.

fields.label: Steps
fields.value: Researching → Mapping the new concepts → Review → Writing → Ready

states.loading: The progress list with the current step spinning.
states.empty: No extension for this course: the page shows the course's last build, as today.
states.error: A failed step shows its message with Try again, as a failed build does today.
states.success: Approving starts writing; 'Read the course meanwhile' links back to the course page.

fields.label: What should it add?
fields.placeholder: Advanced strategies, options pricing, building a live trading system…

components.control: Menu item 'Extend this course' in the existing Course options menu, opening a Modal with a Textarea
components.why: a rare, deliberate action; the menu already holds the course's other whole-course action (Delete) and keeps the header to one primary button
components.rejected: a second header button (competes with Continue) and a page of its own (one field does not need one)

components.control: Alert banner above the modules while an extension is planning, waiting for review, or writing
components.why: the course stays readable during an extension, so the page must say what is happening without blocking it
components.rejected: redirecting to the build page as a new course does (it would hide a readable course)

components.control: The existing build page and OutlineReview, with existing modules collapsed and labelled
components.why: one review flow for new courses and extensions; the outline chat already edits only the new modules

endpoints.purpose: adds extension: {status: planning|review|writing|failed, jobId, modules} (new field)
